story.headline: Socho: ek khidki, ek *Sharma ji.*
story.body: Pehle aadmi ke liye Sharma ji register pakad lete hain. Woh aadmi ATM chala gaya. *Ab poori line khadi hai.*

trap.headline: Lock pakad ke *payment ka wait*
trap.body: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` held through payment. One slow user blocks everyone. *More traffic = fewer bookings.*

fix.headline: Dus minute ki parchi: *TTL hold*
fix.body: Atomic `DECR` on the seat count, then a 10-min hold with expiry. *Payment fail? Seat goes back automatically.*

caption:
Tatkal khulte hi seat 1 second mein gayab kyun hoti hai? Server slow nahi hota, locking galat hoti hai. 6 slides mein samjho: row lock trap, TTL hold aur atomic decrement.

cover.headline: Paisa kat gaya, payment *pending*. Ab kya?

story.headline: Kirana wale bhaiya ka *hisaab*
story.body: Aapne note diya, bhaiya ne galla khola, tabhi light chali gayi. Note gaya ya nahi? Bhaiya *raat ko hisaab milate hain.*

trap.headline: Timeout aaya? *Phir se bhejo*
trap.body: Blind retry without a key can mean a *double debit*. The first request may have succeeded; the app just never heard back.

fix.headline: Har payment ka *ek ID*
fix.body: Send an `idempotency key` with each request. Same key = same result, no second debit. Status unclear? *Reconcile, don't retry blindly.*

caption:
UPI mein paisa kat gaya par payment pending kyun dikhta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: timeouts, idempotency key aur reconciliation.

cover.headline: Last over, crore log live. *Server kaise bache?*

story.headline: Stadium ke bahar *chaiwala*
story.body: Match ke din chaiwala subah se chai bana ke rakhta hai. Agar wicket girne ke baad banana shuru kare, *bheed chali jaayegi.*

trap.headline: Load badha? *Autoscale* kar denge
trap.body: New servers take minutes to boot. The spike hits in seconds. *By the time they're up, viewers have left.*

fix.headline: Pehle se taiyaar: *pre-warm + CDN*
fix.body: Scale up before the match using the schedule. Serve video segments from `CDN edges` near viewers, so *origin sees a fraction.*

caption:
Last over mein crore log ek saath live dekhte hain, phir bhi stream kaise chalti hai? 6 slides mein samjho: autoscaling ka trap, pre-warming aur CDN.

story.headline: Society guard ka *register*
story.body: Guard har flat ka distance nahi naapta. Woh wing dekhta hai: B-wing ka parcel, B-wing ke paas wala bhaiya. *Pehle area, phir distance.*

trap.headline: Har rider se *distance* naapo
trap.body: Checking distance to every rider for every order is O(N) per request. *At city scale, matching gets slow fast.*

fix.headline: Shehar ko *grid* mein baanto
fix.body: Bucket riders by `geohash` cell. For an order, check its cell and the neighbours only. *Search a few riders, not the city.*

caption:
Lakhon riders mein se sabse paas wala rider seconds mein kaise milta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: O(N) scan ka trap, geohash aur spatial index.

story.headline: Mohalle ka *kirana*, warehouse nahi
story.body: Kirana wale bhaiya ki dukaan gali ke kone pe hai, saaman pehle se rakha hai. Aur jo aakhri packet hai, *woh aapke naam pe alag rakh dete hain.*

trap.body: Accepting orders before reserving stock lets two users buy the last packet. *One of them gets a cancel call.*

fix.headline: Pehle *reserve*, phir pack

cover.headline: OTP aaya *2 minute baad*. Tab tak expire.

story.headline: Daakiya aur *ek hi thaila*
story.body: Daakiya ke thaile mein shaadi ke card, bill aur ek urgent telegram sab mix hain. Telegram neeche dab gaya. *Urgent cheez line mein phansi hai.*

trap.headline: Sab SMS *ek hi queue* mein
trap.body: OTPs wait behind a marketing blast in one shared queue. *By the time it arrives, the OTP has expired.*

fix.headline: OTP ki *VIP line*
fix.body: A separate `priority queue` for OTPs, a short TTL, and failover to a second SMS provider. *Offer a voice or in-app fallback.*

OTP hamesha tab aata hai jab expire ho chuka hota hai? 6 slides mein samjho: shared queue ka trap, priority queue aur backup SMS route.

cover.headline: Ek tick, do tick, *blue tick*. Kaun bhejta hai?

story.headline: Dabbawala ki *teen parchi*
story.body: Dabba station pahuncha: ek parchi. Office ke desk pe: doosri. Saab ne dabba khola: teesri. *Har parchi alag jagah se aati hai.*

trap.headline: Ek hi *status* sab jagah?
trap.body: If the app guesses status locally, a message stuck on the server still looks delivered. *Every tick must be a real ack.*

fix.headline: Har hop ka *apna ack*
fix.body: Server ack = 1 tick. Receiver's device ack = 2 ticks. Read event sent back = blue. *Acks travel the same path in reverse.*

cta.question: Read receipts: *on ya off* by default?

caption:
Chat apps mein ek tick, do tick aur blue tick asal mein kaun bhejta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: per-hop acks, store-and-forward aur read receipts.

cover.headline: Phone band, phir bhi *online*? Yeh hai wajah

story.headline: Society guard ki *haazri*
story.body: Guard har kuch minute mein awaaz lagata hai: 'Sab theek?' Jo jawab de, woh andar hai. *Jawab band, toh thodi der baad bahar maana jaata hai.*

trap.headline: *Logout* pe hi offline karo
trap.body: Phones rarely log out cleanly: battery dies, network drops. *Wait for a logout event and users look online forever.*

fix.headline: Heartbeat + *TTL*
fix.body: The app pings every few seconds; the server stores `online` with a short TTL. *No ping, key expires, user goes offline.*

caption:
Phone switch off hai, phir bhi app 'online' dikhata hai? 6 slides mein samjho: logout ka trap, heartbeat aur TTL wala presence.

story.headline: Mandir ki *ek daan-peti*
story.body: Diwali pe sab ek hi daan-peti pe toot pade, line lag gayi. Pujari ji ne das petiyaan rakh di, *raat ko sab jod li.*

trap.headline: Ek row, *sabka UPDATE*
trap.body: Every like runs `likes = likes + 1` on one row. Writes queue on the same row lock. *Hot row, slow app.*

fix.headline: Das counter, *baad mein jodo*
fix.body: Spread increments across N shard counters and sum them on read or in batches. *The count can lag a second; nobody minds.*

caption:
Viral post pe ek saath lakhon likes aate hain, counter phir bhi kaise chalta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: hot row ka trap, sharded counters aur eventual consistency.

cover.headline: Star ne post kiya. *Ek server* pighal gaya

story.headline: Ek hi *halwai* ki dukaan
story.body: Shaadi mein sab ek hi halwai ke jalebi counter pe khade hain. Baaki counter khaali. *Problem bheed nahi, ek hi counter hai.*

trap.headline: Post ID se *shard* karo
trap.body: Shard by post ID and one viral post lands on one shard. *That node melts while the others sit idle.*

fix.headline: Hot key ko *copy* karo
fix.body: Detect hot keys, replicate them across cache nodes, and add a local in-memory cache. *Reads spread out; one node stops burning.*

caption:
Ek celebrity post aur poora server down? 6 slides mein samjho: hot partition ka trap, hot key replication aur local cache.

story.headline: Akhbaar wala ya *library*?
story.body: Akhbaar wala subah har ghar mein paper daal deta hai. Library mein khud jaake padhna padta hai. *Ek mein kaam pehle, ek mein baad mein.*

trap.headline: Sabke liye *same strategy*
trap.body: Fan-out on write for a celebrity means millions of inbox writes per post. *Fan-out on read for everyone makes feeds slow.*

fix.headline: *Hybrid*: normal push, star pull
fix.body: Push posts into followers' feeds for normal users. For celebrities, merge their posts at read time. *Best of both.*

caption:
App kholte hi feed turant aa jaata hai, par bana kab? 6 slides mein samjho: fan-out on write, fan-out on read aur celebrity ke liye hybrid.

story.headline: Mandi ka *sabziwala*
story.body: Subah tamatar kam aaye, grahak zyada. Sabziwala ek-ek grahak se nahi poochta, *poori mandi ka mood dekh ke daam badalta hai.*

trap.body: Querying all drivers and requests on every booking is slow and costly. *Prices lag behind real demand.*

fix.headline: Zone-wise *live counter*
fix.body: Stream ride requests and driver pings per zone, keep rolling counts for the last few minutes, and *price from demand/supply.*

cta.question: Surge: *cap lagao* ya ratio decide kare?

cover.headline: Do letter type kiye, *poora sawaal* aa gaya

story.headline: Library ke *index cards*
story.body: Librarian ke 'P' wale drawer mein 'Pa', usme 'Pan'. Aur har drawer ke upar *sabse popular 5 kitaabein likhi hain.*

trap.headline: Har keystroke pe *DB scan*
trap.body: A `LIKE 'pa%'` query on every keystroke, ranked on the fly. *Millions of keystrokes, millions of slow queries.*

fix.headline: Trie + *top-5 cached*
fix.body: Store queries in a trie; each node keeps its top-k suggestions precomputed. *Lookup is just walking the prefix.*

caption:
Do letter type karte hi poora sawaal kaise aa jaata hai? 6 slides mein samjho: DB scan ka trap, trie aur cached top-k suggestions.

cover.headline: Lamba link, 7 letter ka. *Collision kyun nahi?*

story.headline: Darzi ki *token parchi*
story.body: Darzi har kapde pe ek chhota token number lagata hai aur register mein likh leta hai. Token do, kapda lo. *Number kabhi repeat nahi hota.*

trap.headline: Random code, *ummeed karo*
trap.body: Random 7-char codes plus 'hope it's free' means a collision check on every write. *As the table grows, retries grow too.*

fix.headline: Unique ID, phir *base62*
fix.body: Get a unique numeric ID from an ID generator or counter range, then encode it in `base62`. *7 chars cover ~3.5 trillion codes.*

caption:
Itna lamba link 7 letters mein kaise fit hota hai, aur collision kyun nahi hota? 6 slides mein samjho: random code ka trap, unique IDs aur base62.

story.headline: Golgappe wale ki *plate*
story.body: Bhaiya har kuch second mein ek golgappa dete hain, plate mein max 5 jama ho sakte hain. *Jaldi khaoge toh rukna padega.*

trap.headline: Koi limit nahi, *sab aane do*
trap.body: With no limit, one bot or buggy client can flood your login or OTP API. *Everyone else gets slow responses.*

fix.headline: *Token bucket* har user ka
fix.body: Each user gets a bucket that refills at a fixed rate; each request spends a token. Empty = `429`. *Bursts OK, floods not.*

caption:
'Too many attempts, try again in 30 seconds' kaun decide karta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: no-limit ka trap, token bucket aur 429 responses.

story.headline: Mele ka *jhoola*
story.body: Jhoole mein 100 seat, bahar hazaron log. Samajhdar organiser bahar line lagwata hai aur *sirf utne hi andar bhejta hai jitni seat hain.*

trap.headline: Pehle *read*, phir update
trap.body: Read stock = 1, then update. Thousands read '1' at the same moment. *Everyone buys the last phone.*

fix.headline: Line lagao, *atomic* ghatao
fix.body: A `waiting room` admits users at a safe rate; stock drops with one atomic decrement that fails at zero. *No negative stock.*

caption:
Flash sale mein 100 phone aur 101 orders, yeh kaise hota hai? 6 slides mein samjho: read-then-write ka trap, waiting room aur atomic decrement.

cover.headline: Do log, ek hi seat *H7*. Kisko milegi?

story.headline: Shaadi mein *kursi pe rumaal*
story.body: Kursi pe rumaal rakh do, kursi tumhari. Par 10 minute mein wapas nahi aaye, *toh rumaal hata ke koi aur baith jaayega.*

trap.headline: Poore show pe *ek lock*
trap.body: Locking the whole show while one user picks seats makes everyone else wait. *One slow picker freezes the theatre.*

fix.headline: Har seat ka *alag check*
fix.body: Update one seat only if it's still free: `WHERE status='free'`. 0 rows updated = someone else won. *Hold it with a TTL.*

caption:
Do log ek hi seat ek saath select karein, toh seat kisko milti hai? 6 slides mein samjho: show-level lock ka trap, per-seat conditional update aur TTL hold.

story.headline: Kabaddi coach ki *score diary*
story.body: Coach har point pe poori list dobara nahi likhta. Diary pehle se score ke order mein hai, *bas ek naam upar-neeche hota hai.*

trap.headline: Har ball pe *ORDER BY*
trap.body: Re-sorting millions of rows with `ORDER BY points` on every update and refresh. *The DB spends all day sorting.*

fix.headline: Redis *sorted set*
fix.body: Keep scores in a sorted set: updates and rank lookups are O(log N). `ZREVRANGE` gives the top 10 fast. *Persist to DB async.*

caption:
Fantasy app mein lakhon users ki rank har ball pe kaise update hoti hai? 6 slides mein samjho: ORDER BY ka trap aur Redis sorted sets.

cover.headline: Score refresh kiya *100 baar*. Server ka kya?

story.headline: Chacha ka *radio*
story.body: Har over pe chacha se poochte raho 'score kya hua?', dono thak jaoge. Radio on karo, *score khud bata deta hai jab badalta hai.*

trap.headline: Har 2 sec *polling*
trap.body: Millions of clients ask every 2 seconds, and most answers are 'no change'. *Most of your traffic is wasted.*

fix.headline: Server *push* kare
fix.body: Use `SSE` for one-way score pushes, WebSocket if the app also sends data. Push only on change, *fan out via pub/sub.*

caption:
Live score ke liye app baar baar refresh kare ya server khud bataye? 6 slides mein samjho: polling ka trap, SSE, WebSocket aur pub/sub.

cover.headline: Cache lagaya. Phir bhi *DB down* kyun?

story.headline: Chaiwale ki *ek ketli*
story.body: Ketli khaali hui, aur 50 log ek saath bole 'nayi bana do'. Bhaiya 50 ketli chadhate toh gas khatam. *Ek banao, sabko wahi do.*

trap.headline: Sab keys ka *same TTL*
trap.body: A hot key expires, thousands of requests miss at once and all hit the DB. *Same TTL everywhere means mass expiry.*

fix.headline: *Ek request* DB tak jaaye
fix.body: Request coalescing: one request rebuilds the key, the rest wait or get *stale data*. Add `jitter` so keys don't expire together.

caption:
Cache lagane ke baad bhi database down kyun ho jaata hai? 6 slides mein samjho: cache stampede, request coalescing aur jittered TTL.

cover.headline: Server wapas aaya, *phir se down*. Kyun?

story.headline: Bank khulte hi *dhakka-mukki*
story.body: Bank 10 minute band raha. Khulte hi sab ek saath andar ghuse, clerk ne phir counter band kar diya. *Sabko alag-alag time pe aana tha.*

trap.headline: Fail hua? *Turant retry*
trap.body: Every client retries instantly and in sync. The recovering server gets hit by all of them at once. *It falls over again.*

fix.headline: Backoff + *jitter*
fix.body: Wait 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s between retries, add random `jitter`, and cap the retries. *Clients spread out; the server recovers.*

caption:
Server outage ke baad wapas aata hai aur turant phir down kyun ho jaata hai? 6 slides mein samjho: retry storm, exponential backoff aur jitter.

cover.headline: Ek server add kiya, *poora cache khaali?*

story.headline: Socho: postman ke *4 thaile*
story.body: Postman letters ko house number mod 4 se thaile mein daalta hai. 5th thaila aaya toh har letter ka thaila badal gaya. *Sab dobara sort karo.*

trap.headline: `hash % N` = *har key shift*
trap.body: Change N from 4 to 5 and about 80% of keys map to a new server. *Cache empties, the DB gets hammered.*

fix.headline: Hash *ring* pe servers rakho
fix.body: Keys and servers sit on a hash ring. A new server takes keys only from its neighbour: *about 1/N of keys move, not all.*

caption:
Naya server add karte hi cache khaali kyun ho jaata hai? 6 slides mein samjho: hash % N ka trap, hash ring aur virtual nodes.

story.headline: School register mein *Rohan* dhoondho
story.body: Principal sahab har page palat rahe hain, kyunki register roll number se sorted hai, naam se nahi. *Peeche alphabetical index hota toh 2 second.*

trap.headline: `WHERE email = ?` bina *index*
trap.body: No index on email means a full table scan: the DB reads every row. *Fine at 1,000 rows, painful at 10 million.*

fix.headline: Index = *book ka peecha*
fix.body: A B-tree index on email turns the scan into a few page lookups (log n). *Cost: slower writes and extra storage.*

caption:
1 crore rows mein ek email dhoondhne mein 30 second kyun? 6 slides: full table scan ka trap, B-tree index aur uski cost.

cover.headline: Ek database *full ho gaya*. Ab kya?

story.headline: Bank clerk ki *ek hi almari*
story.body: Saare khaate ek almari mein. Almari bhar gayi, clerk thak gaya. Bank ne A-M aur N-Z ki alag almari bana di. *Har clerk ka kaam aadha.*

trap.headline: Sab data *ek machine* pe
trap.body: Vertical scaling hits a ceiling: biggest box, biggest bill, single point of failure. *One machine can only grow so much.*

fix.headline: `user_id` se *shard* karo
fix.body: Route each user by hash(user_id) to a shard, so load spreads out. *Catch: cross-shard joins get hard.*

caption:
Database full ho gaya, bada server bhi kaafi nahi? 6 slides: vertical scaling ka trap, user_id sharding aur uske trade-offs.

story.headline: Society guard ka *register copy*
story.body: Main gate guard entry likhta hai, back gate guard ko copy 5 minute baad milti hai. Tum back gate pe poocho: *'Entry hai?' Woh bolega nahi.*

trap.headline: Write primary, *read replica*
trap.body: Async replication takes milliseconds to seconds. Read right after a write from a replica and *your own comment isn't there yet.*

fix.headline: *Read-your-writes* rakho
fix.body: After a write, route that user's reads to the primary for a few seconds, or wait for the replica to catch up. *Others can still read replicas.*

caption:
Comment post kiya aur refresh pe gayab? Bug nahi, replica lag hai. 6 slides: async replication ka trap aur read-your-writes fix.

cover.headline: Network toota. ATM *paisa de ya mana kare?*

story.headline: Gaon ka ATM, *bank se cut*
story.body: Cable kat gayi. ATM ko pata nahi tumhara balance kya hai. Do raaste: paisa de do (risk), ya 'service unavailable'. *Dono ek saath nahi.*

trap.headline: *Teeno* chahiye: C, A, P
trap.body: During a network partition you can't be both fully consistent and fully available. *Partitions happen, so P isn't optional.*

fix.headline: Partition mein *choose* karo
fix.body: Payments usually pick CP: refuse rather than be wrong. Likes and feeds pick AP: *show slightly stale data, stay up.*

caption:
Network toot jaaye toh ATM paisa de ya mana kare? Yahi CAP theorem hai. 6 slides: 'teeno chahiye' ka trap aur CP vs AP choice.

story.headline: Mumbai ka *dabbawala* system
story.body: Ghar se dabba seedha office nahi jaata. Station pe crate mein jaata hai, phir train se. Kitchen ko office ka wait nahi karna padta. *Crate = buffer.*

trap.headline: Order API *seedha* sab call kare
trap.body: Checkout synchronously calls payment, inventory, email and SMS. *One slow service and every order times out.*

fix.headline: Beech mein *queue* rakho
fix.body: The API writes an order event to a queue and returns. Workers consume at their own pace. *Spikes get absorbed, not dropped.*

caption:
Sale shuru hote hi orders ka tsunami. App kaise bachega? 6 slides: synchronous calls ka trap aur message queue fix, dabbawala style.

cover.headline: Ek kharab message ne *poori queue rok di*

story.headline: Postman aur *galat address*
story.body: Ek chitthi ka address galat hai. Postman roz wahi chitthi try karta hai, baaki thaila wait karta hai. *Smart postman use 'undelivered' dabbe mein daalta hai.*

trap.headline: Fail hua? *Retry forever*
trap.body: A malformed message fails, goes back to the head of the queue and fails again. *Everything behind it is stuck.*

fix.headline: 3 retries, phir *DLQ*
fix.body: Retry with backoff a few times, then park the message in a dead letter queue. *The queue keeps moving; inspect and replay later.*

caption:
Ek kharab message ne poori queue kaise rok di? 6 slides: retry-forever ka trap aur dead letter queue fix.

story.headline: Chaiwale ko *do baar* paise
story.body: Tumne paise diye, bhaiya ne suna nahi, tumne phir de diye. Smart chaiwala tumhari parchi ka number dekhta hai: *'Yeh wala toh mil gaya.'*

trap.headline: Timeout aaya? *Phir se charge*
trap.body: The network drops the response, the app retries, the server charges again. *Retries without dedup = double debit.*

fix.headline: Har request ki *parchi*
fix.body: The client sends an `Idempotency-Key` header. The server stores key + result; *same key again returns the same result, no new charge.*

story.headline: Ghar ka *MCB* yaad hai?
story.body: Geyser mein short circuit hua toh MCB trip ho jaata hai. Poore ghar ki wiring nahi jalti. *Ek kamra andhera, baaki ghar chalu.*

trap.headline: Down service ko *call karte raho*
trap.body: Every request waits 30s for a dead dependency. Threads pile up and the caller dies too. *One failure cascades.*

fix.headline: Fail ho toh *circuit khol do*
fix.body: After N failures the breaker opens: calls fail fast and serve a fallback. *It half-opens later to test recovery.*

cover.headline: 4 servers, phir bhi *ek hi pe load?*

story.headline: Railway ke *4 counter*
story.body: Guard har naye aadmi ko baari baari counter 1, 2, 3, 4 bhejta hai. Par counter 2 pe ek form 20 minute le raha hai. *Line wahin atak gayi.*

trap.headline: Sirf *round robin* pe bharosa
trap.body: Round robin assumes every request costs the same. *Slow requests pile up on one server* while others sit idle.

fix.headline: *Least connections* chuno
fix.body: Send each new request to the server with the fewest active connections, plus health checks to skip sick ones. *Load follows actual work.*

4 servers hain, phir bhi ek hi server pe load kyun? 6 slides: round robin ka trap aur least connections fix, railway counter style.

cover.headline: Server Mumbai mein, user Patna mein. *Video fast?*

story.headline: Kirana bhaiya ka *paas ka godown*
story.body: Bhaiya har packet Delhi factory se nahi mangwate. Mohalle ke godown mein stock rakhte hain. *Maal paas ho toh delivery 10 minute.*

trap.headline: Har request *origin* tak
trap.body: Every user fetches the video from one far-away origin. Long round trips, an overloaded origin, *buffering for everyone.*

fix.headline: Content *user ke paas* rakho
fix.body: A CDN caches files on edge servers near users. The first request warms the edge; *the rest are served locally.*

story.headline: Phone ki *contact list* jaisa
story.body: Tum 'Mummy' pe call karte ho, number yaad nahi rakhte. Contact list naam ko number mein badalti hai. *DNS domain ko IP mein badalta hai.*

trap.headline: IP badla, users *purane server* pe
trap.body: You move servers, but the old record had a 24h TTL. Resolvers keep serving the cached IP. *Users hit the dead box for hours.*

fix.headline: Migration se pehle *TTL ghatao*
fix.body: Lower the TTL to about 60s a day before moving, switch the record, raise it again later. *Caches expire fast, traffic moves fast.*

caption:
google.com type karte hi phone ko server ka address kaise milta hai? 6 slides: DNS lookup, TTL ka trap aur safe migration.

cover.headline: Cafe WiFi pe password. *Koi padh sakta hai?*

story.headline: *Taala* bhejo, chaabi nahi
story.body: Bank tumhe khula taala bhejta hai, chaabi apne paas rakhta hai. Tum dabba band karke bhejo. *Raste mein koi khol nahi sakta.*

trap.headline: Plain *HTTP* pe login
trap.body: Over HTTP, anyone on the same WiFi or network path can read and change the traffic. *Passwords travel as plain text.*

fix.headline: HTTPS: *handshake* pehle
fix.body: TLS checks the server's certificate, agrees a session key using public-key crypto, then encrypts everything. *Snoopers see only noise.*

caption:
Cafe WiFi pe password daala, koi padh toh nahi lega? 6 slides: plain HTTP ka trap aur TLS handshake, taala-chaabi style.

story.body: Register wale mele mein guard har baar list check karta hai. Wristband wale mein bas band dekh leta hai. *Band chori hua toh? Woh shaam tak chalega.*

trap.headline: 7 din wala *JWT*, no revoke
trap.body: A JWT is checked by signature only. Logout deletes it on your phone, but a stolen copy *works until it expires.*

fix.headline: *Short* JWT + refresh token
fix.body: The access token lives about 15 min. The refresh token sits server-side and can be revoked. *Logout = revoke refresh; access dies soon.*

caption:
Logout kiya phir bhi account khula kaise? 6 slides: long-lived JWT ka trap, sessions vs JWT, aur refresh token fix.

cover.headline: Forgot password pe *purana password kyun nahi?*

story.headline: Atta *roti ban gaya*, wapas nahi
story.body: Atta se roti banti hai, roti se atta nahi. Site tumhara password roti bana ke rakhti hai. *Login pe nayi roti banao, match karo.*

trap.headline: Password *plain text* mein
trap.body: Store raw passwords (or plain MD5) and one DB leak exposes every user, and *their other accounts too*, since people reuse.

fix.headline: *bcrypt* + salt, slow by design
fix.body: Hash with a slow algorithm (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2) and a unique salt per user. *Same password, different hash; brute force gets expensive.*

caption:
Forgot password pe site tumhara purana password kyun nahi bhejti? Kyunki usse pata hi nahi. 6 slides: plain text ka trap aur salted slow hashing.

story.headline: Token counter wali *ek machine*
story.body: Hospital mein har floor ek hi token machine se number leta hai. Machine kharab, poora hospital ruk gaya. *Har floor apna prefix laga de toh?*

trap.headline: Sab servers *ek DB counter* se
trap.body: Every insert asks one auto-increment counter. It becomes a bottleneck and a single point of failure. *Shards can't even share it.*

fix.headline: *Time + machine + seq* ID
fix.body: A 64-bit ID = timestamp + machine id + per-ms sequence. Each server makes IDs alone, *roughly time-sorted, no coordination.*

caption:
10 servers ek hi counter se ID maang rahe hain, sab atak gaye. 6 slides: central counter ka trap aur Snowflake-style IDs.

story.headline: Society guard ki *yaaddasht*
story.body: Guard ko har flat ka naam yaad nahi, par jo naam usne kabhi nahi suna, woh turant bol deta hai: *'Yahan koi nahi rehta.'* Shak ho toh register dekhta hai.

trap.headline: Har keystroke pe *DB query*
trap.body: Checking millions of usernames in the database on every keystroke adds load and latency. *Most checks are for names nobody took.*

fix.headline: Pehle *Bloom filter* se poocho
fix.body: A Bloom filter in memory says 'definitely not taken' or 'maybe taken'. *No false negatives*; only the maybes hit the DB.

caption:
Username type karte hi 'already taken' turant kaise aata hai? 6 slides: har keystroke pe DB query ka trap aur Bloom filter fix.

story.headline: Line mein *'5th se aage'* bolna
story.body: Ration line mein tum bolte ho 'mujhe 5th ke baad wale chahiye'. Beech mein 2 log aur ghus gaye. *Ab 5th wala koi aur hai.*

trap.headline: `OFFSET 20` wali *pagination*
trap.body: New posts arrive, rows shift, and page 2 repeats or skips items. *Large offsets are slow too: the DB still scans them.*

fix.headline: *Cursor* se agla page
fix.body: Return a cursor (the last seen id). The next page asks `WHERE id < cursor`. *Stable under inserts, fast with an index.*

caption:
Infinite scroll mein wahi post dobara kyun aa jaati hai? 6 slides: OFFSET pagination ka trap aur cursor pagination fix.

cover.headline: Light gayi beech mein. *Data bacha kaise?*

story.headline: Munshi ji ki *rough copy*
story.body: Munshi ji khaata badalne se pehle rough copy mein likhte hain: 'Ramesh ko 500 diye'. Beech mein light gayi? *Rough copy padh ke khaata theek.*

trap.headline: Seedha *data file* badlo
trap.body: Update data pages in place and a crash mid-write leaves half-written pages, *with no record of what was in flight.*

fix.headline: Pehle *log*, phir data
fix.body: Append the change to a write-ahead log and flush it to disk; update pages later. After a crash, *replay the log to recover committed work.*

caption:
Database write ke beech light chali gayi, phir bhi data kaise bach gaya? 6 slides: in-place update ka trap aur write-ahead log.

story.headline: Socho: darzi ke paas *ek thaan kapda*
story.body: Rafiq bhai darzi ek kapde se S, M, L, XL sab sizes kaatte hain. Ek-ek karke kaatenge toh *customer ghanton wait karega.*

trap.headline: Upload request mein hi *transcode*
trap.body: The API server encodes 1080p, 720p and 480p one by one inside the request. *Request times out, CPU stuck.*

fix.headline: Upload karo, *queue mein daalo*
fix.body: Store the raw file, push a job to a `queue`, and workers encode each rendition in parallel. *Video goes live as renditions finish.*

caption:

story.headline: Socho: dabbawala ka *chhota dabba*
story.body: Traffic jam ho toh Ganesh bhau chhota dabba le jaate hain, par lunch time pe pahunchte hain. *Khana ruka nahi, bas halka hua.*

trap.headline: Ek hi *1080p file* sabko bhejo
trap.body: One fixed high-bitrate stream for everyone. On a weak network the player drains its buffer and *spins forever.*

fix.headline: Chhote *segments*, har bitrate mein
fix.body: Video is cut into short segments at several bitrates. The player measures speed and *picks the next segment's quality.*

fix.headline: Resize + compress, *ek baar*
fix.body: Resize to screen width and use lossy compression (JPEG/WebP). Reuse the stored file on forward to *avoid re-encoding loss.*

cover.headline: Do log, ek doc. *Kiska typing bachega?*

story.headline: Socho: munshi ji ka *ek hisaab register*
story.body: Do munshi ek hi register mein likh rahe hain. Ek apna page phaad ke naya chipka de toh *doosre ka kaam gaya.*

trap.headline: Last save wins: *poora doc overwrite*
trap.body: Each client sends the whole document. Whoever saves last silently *erases the other person's edits.*

fix.headline: Poora doc nahi, *operations* bhejo
fix.body: Send small ops like `insert(5, 'a')`. OT or CRDTs merge concurrent ops so *every client converges to the same text.*

caption:
Do log ek hi doc mein type karein toh kiska text bachta hai? 6 slides mein samjho: last-write-wins trap, operations aur OT/CRDT merge.

story.headline: Socho: darzi sirf *phati jeb* silta hai
story.body: Kurte ki jeb phati toh Salim darzi naya kurta nahi banata, bas jeb silta hai. *Sirf jo badla, wahi theek.*

trap.headline: Har change pe *poori file* bhejo
trap.body: Re-uploading the whole file on every save wastes bandwidth and time. *Big files never finish syncing.*

fix.headline: File ko *chunks* mein todo
fix.body: Split the file into chunks and hash each one. Upload only chunks whose `hash` changed; *the server stitches the new version.*

story.body: Bahadur ji 500 flats mein khud jaayenge toh raat ho jaayegi. Woh *wing-wise volunteers* ko bolte hain, sab parallel.

trap.headline: Ek loop, *har user ko ek-ek* bhejo
trap.body: A single server loops over millions of device tokens one by one. *Last user gets the alert after the match ends.*

fix.headline: Queue + workers: *parallel fan-out*
fix.body: Put the event on a `queue`, split recipients into batches, and many workers call APNs/FCM in parallel *with retries.*

trap.headline: Exact match: *0 results*

fix.headline: Fuzzy match: *edit distance 1-2*
fix.body: Index with n-grams and allow 1-2 character edits (Levenshtein). Rank matches by *closeness + popularity.*

story.body: Verma madam copies jis order mein aayi, us order mein nahi padhti. *Roll number dekh ke* sort karti hain.

trap.headline: Phone ki *clock* pe bharosa
trap.body: Phone clocks drift and networks reorder packets. Sorting by device time shows *replies before questions.*

fix.headline: Server de *per-chat sequence*

cover.headline: Naya version aaya, *app down* kyun hua?

story.headline: Socho: chaiwale ka *doosra stove*
story.body: Pappu chaiwala naya stove lagata hai toh purana band nahi karta. Naya garam ho jaaye, *tab customers shift.*

trap.headline: Server band, deploy, *phir start*
trap.body: Stop old, copy new, restart. For those minutes every request fails, and a bad build means *a long outage.*

fix.headline: Blue-green: *switch, don't stop*
fix.body: Run the new version next to the old one, health-check it, then move traffic (or a 5% canary first). *Rollback = switch back.*

caption:

trap.body: Shipping code turns the feature on for 100% instantly. One bug hits everyone and *rollback needs a redeploy.*

fix.headline: Code ship karo, *flag se kholo*
fix.body: Wrap the feature in `if (flag)`. Turn it on for 1%, watch metrics, ramp up. *Kill switch, no redeploy.*

trap.body: Replication copies every change, including `DELETE FROM users`. *The mistake reaches all replicas in seconds.*

cover.headline: Ek cron job, *do baar salary* gayi?

story.headline: Socho: ek *chaabi*, ek tala
story.body: Office ka safe ek hai, chaabi ek. Jiske paas chaabi, sirf wahi Venkat sir *salary nikaal sakte hain.*

trap.headline: Har server pe *same cron* chalao
trap.body: Two or three app servers run the same cron at 9:00. Each one runs payroll and *pays everyone again.*

fix.headline: Pehle lock lo, *phir chalao*
fix.body: Acquire a lock with expiry (e.g. Redis `SET NX PX`). Only the winner runs, and the job stays *idempotent anyway.*

story.body: Seth ji purani entry kabhi nahi mitate. Naya len-den neeche likhte hain. *Hisaab = saari entries ka total.*

trap.headline: `UPDATE balance` *seedha overwrite*

fix.headline: Entries likho, *balance nikaalo*
fix.body: Append every debit and credit as an immutable entry. Balance is the sum (cached as a snapshot), and *history is the audit.*
